notes: JPEGs keep the original viewport dimensions. The renderer may internally cap its drawing-buffer resolution; diagnostics record that cap.
State, diagnostics and DOM bounds are sampled immediately before the screenshot; state is verified again immediately afterward.
DOM rectangles describe CSS boxes and text line boxes, not exact painted glyph outlines. Overlaps and clipping are candidates for visual review.
Current source hashes are recorded for every capture. Served response hashes separately identify the source bytes loaded by each browser.
A software-rendered Chromium capture is visual evidence, not a hardware performance benchmark.

This final matrix combines 90 captures from the initial batch and all 18 captures of a fresh 4K retry. The first 4K attempt exceeded the screenshot tool's 30-second deadline at Strike enter. The retry changed only that deadline to 120 seconds; source, viewport, DPR, quality, readiness and narrative state checks stayed unchanged. Original reports and the six superseded 4K images remain in an internal QA archive and are not included in the delivery; compact provenance and hashes are retained in capture-attempts.json.

recoveredFailures.resolution: The entire 4K viewport was recaptured successfully with a 120000 ms screenshot timeout, unchanged scene quality and identical source hashes.
